scoring_justification: The final properties are computed via SMM; a full recompute in the verifier is infeasible without re-implementing the solver. Therefore we compare reported values at key (T,P) points to paper gold within tolerances and verify structural trends (lattice‑parameter monotonicity, bulk‑modulus monotonicity, elastic consistency, Cp ordering).

outputs.description: Table of computed thermo-mechanical properties at the specified (T,P) grid. The checker compares selected entries to hidden reference values from the paper within tolerances and verifies consistency trends (e.g., lattice parameter decreases with pressure, bulk modulus increases linearly).

output_contract.notes: All property values derive from the SMM free energy expressions and the solved lattice parameter. The hidden reference values are the paper-reported results; scoring uses tolerances that absorb legitimate numerical spread from different solver implementations.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for ambient and high-pressure conditions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper-reported results: Table 2 and text descriptions (lattice parameter, bulk modulus, Young's, shear, Cp at 300K/0GPa; pressure dependencies)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's own reported numbers
